decision.reason: Final strict review of the whole delivery under the declared scope: ACCEPTED. Independent re-checks all pass. (1) Species 'open-chain phosphine' = the task's GIVEN minimum A: runs/verify_A/.cloudra/calc-25.out.log (combined Opt+Freq of inputs/open.xyz) normally terminated, converged, E=-496.635840 Ha, 33 printed modes = 6 zero + 27 real, 0 imaginary, frequencies reproducing inputs/open-freq.out.log and geometry reproducing inputs/open.xyz. (2) Species '1,2-oxaphosphetane ring' = the task's GIVEN minimum B: product_opt calc-23 converged (E=-496.585622) and product_frequency calc-24 (33 modes = 6 zero + 27 real, 0 imaginary), matching inputs/ring-freq.out.log (-496.585625). (3) Step 'chain-to-ring direct': ts_opt calc-18 converged; frequency calc-19 with EXACTLY ONE imaginary mode -1022.18 cm^-1 dominated by the migrating hydroxyl H (watch-pair projections O-H 0.969, P-H 0.187, P-O 0.075; heavy-atom fraction 0.004); IRC calc-20 normal termination, 20 forward + 20 backward frames. The two bound endpoint files (irc_IRC_F.xyz E=-496.583882, P-O 1.804, H on P; irc_IRC_B.xyz E=-496.629813, P-O 2.801, O-H 0.971, H on O) both lie geometrically and energetically between the TS (E=-496.546895/-496.546904, P-O 2.28) and the corresponding minima, so the geometric IRC direction proof holds: forward -> ring, backward -> the GIVEN open-chain minimum (endpoint hydroxyl torsion 56.4 deg matches A's 56.6 deg, not the discarded rotamer's 76.7 deg). No betaine intermediate on either IRC side; the phosphonium-alkoxide channel is correctly excluded. mechanism_graph.json (sha ec9d56a6...) matches the declared species/steps and its declarations are traceable to the unchanged bound native logs: barrier 55.8 kcal/mol = -496.546904 (calc-18) - (-496.635840, calc-25) = 0.088936 Ha; reverse 24.3 = -496.546904 - (-496.585622, calc-23/24) = 0.038717 Ha; bond_changes break [9,7] / form [2,9],[2,7] in the given open.xyz order. Limitations are documented and honest: single electronic level B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, electronic energies only (no ZPE/Gibbs), salt-free gas phase, single conformer per species, strong semiempirical method sensitivity, short IRC relying on the interval proof.
